sentences.en: Reading this sentence constitutes acceptance of its Terms and Conditions.
sentences.zh: 阅读此句子即表示接受其条款和条件。

sentences.en: His acceptance of the present was regarded as bribery.
sentences.zh: 他接受这份礼物被视为受贿。

sentences.en: I want to read to you my acceptance speech.
sentences.zh: 我想读一下我的获奖感言。
